Class DedupeFilterBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.filter.DedupeFilterBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogBuilder<DedupeFilterBuilder, LogRouter.Router.Filter>
public final class DedupeFilterBuilder extends Object implements LogBuilder<DedupeFilterBuilder, LogRouter.Router.Filter>
Builder to create LogRouter.Router.Filter. Drops an event once its unformatted message has been seen more than repeats times after the first. Messages with arguments are compared before the arguments are filled in, even when the event has already been frozen. Only the cacheSize most recently seen messages are remembered, and a forgotten message counts from the start again. Events more severe than level are always kept.
